name: Ai Doll
original_name: 哀・奴隷（あい・どーる）
source:
Hero drove a car and got into an accident. He regained consciousness in girls monastery. Some strange punishment techniques are practiced there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
